about.body: I'm I Made Pradnya Budi Pratama known as Keprra, a digital business architect who builds ventures at the intersection of sustainability, education, and commerce. I lead teams from idea to award-winning business models, and I ship live products solo, from tax tools to free storefronts for micro-businesses.
about.highlightText: I'm deeply interested in AI-powered CMS — content systems where AI and people build together. Let's build your system with me.

clients.title: Real Projects
clients.intro: Real things I've built and led — client work and my own award-winning ventures.

items.name: SELUS
items.tagline: Sustainable vegan leather from coconut water waste
items.description: A real circular-economy venture built with a team: turning acidic coconut water waste — a pollutant from food vendors in Lebih village, Gianyar, Bali — into vegan leather for fashion, replacing animal-derived materials.
items.role: Team Leader — ideation, business model, go-to-market
items.impact: Won 3 competitions: Business Model Canvas (BMC), Ideasi Bisnis, and a national P2MW grant (~Rp 15M). Reduces organic waterway pollution while offering a cruelty-free leather alternative.

items.name: Sigma Academy
items.description: A real project at the idea/business-plan stage: an education platform that uses AI to match students to professional fields suited to their background, interests, and aptitudes.
items.impact: Won an award in a business-design-strategy competition (Ideasi Bisnis). Tackles underemployment in Indonesia by pairing AI recommendation with labor-market data.

items.name: PT Lano Imaji Nusantara
items.tagline: Content-commerce web platform for a Bali art gallery
items.description: A two-site platform for a contemporary art gallery in Ubud: an e-commerce store for artwork and merchandise, paired with a paid news/content site that drives engagement and a new revenue stream.
items.impact: Introduces a content-commerce flywheel: editorial content (Lano News) acquires customers for Lano Commerce, diversifying revenue and reducing dependence on physical foot traffic.

items.name: Portfolio for Elsa
items.tagline: A personal portfolio website built for a client
items.description: Designed and developed a personal portfolio website for Elsa — a clean, responsive site to present her profile and work, with an in-browser editor (operator).
items.impact: Delivered a polished, mobile-friendly personal brand presence the client can edit herself.

independent.title: Self-Initiated Tools & Ventures
independent.intro: Things I build on my own. Tools open right here — try them without leaving the page.

items.name: Indonesian Tax Suite
items.description: A full tax calculator suite for Indonesian SMEs & employees: PPh Final 0.5% (PP 20/2026), PPh 21 (TER), and a comparison tool — with eligibility checks, thresholds, shareable links, and built-in explanations.
items.impact: Turns complex, changing tax rules into a clear, real-time calculator — handling the Rp 500M tax-free threshold and the Rp 4.8B ceiling with educational guidance.

items.name: Cash Flow Oracle
items.tagline: See when your money runs out — or doubles — before it happens
items.description: Predicts your cash position 12 months ahead from historical income/expense, with a real-time "what-if" simulator (revenue, costs, late payments, capital injection). For Indonesian SMEs & freelancers.
items.impact: Turns raw monthly numbers into a forward-looking runway, burn-rate, trend, and scenario simulator — so owners can see the future before it arrives.

items.name: Profit Leak Detector
items.tagline: Find the money quietly leaking from your business — before it's all gone
items.description: Analyzes your business finances and surfaces 5 hidden types of profit leak, each with a specific rupiah amount and a fix.
items.impact: Makes invisible losses visible — pricing, waste, unpaid invoices, idle cost, leakage — with concrete numbers an owner can act on.

items.name: Business War Room
items.tagline: Three futures. One decision. See them all before you act.
items.description: Simulates up to 3 business decisions in parallel — each a full 12-month financial model — then compares them side by side to guide a big strategic call.
items.impact: Replaces gut-feel big decisions with side-by-side simulated outcomes, so owners choose with evidence, not hope.

items.name: Etalase
items.description: A zero-cost digital catalog generator that lets warung, artisans, and home businesses create a shareable online storefront in minutes, with integrated WhatsApp checkout. No coding, hosting, or upfront cost.
items.impact: The entire storefront is encoded into a shareable URL (base64 state), so one static file serves unlimited storefronts at zero server cost. A built-in dashboard shows per-product margins — helping owners understand their economics.
